english.note: Use this when the amazement is sudden or shocking, with a sense of startling the person.
Use this colloquial form when the astonishment is sudden or shocking and may suggest being startled or frightened.
Use this when the surprise startles or frightens A, rather than pleasantly surprising them.

examples.english: That sudden bang can amaze me.
examples.traditional: 嗰一下巨響可以嚇親我。

examples.english: You suddenly stood behind me—you really did astonish me!
examples.traditional: 你突然企喺我後面，真係嚇親我喇！
examples.jyutping: nei5 dat6 jin4 kei5 hai2 ngo5 hau6 min6 zan1 hai6 haak3 can1 ngo5 laa3

examples.english: You shouted loudly behind me and gave me a nasty surprise!
examples.traditional: 你突然喺我後面大嗌，嚇親我喇！
examples.jyutping: nei5 dat6 jin4 hai2 ngo5 hau6 min6 daai6 ngaai3 haak3 can1 ngo5 laa3
